C1-005.amendment: Define mock-oracle independence mechanically. The shared helper may own traversal/framing bookkeeping, but mock and MLX must retain backend-specific prompt materialization, generation, and independently asserted outcomes. Add literal contract-fixture tests whose marker/status/provenance expectations are not generated by suite_control; cross-runtime parity becomes tautological once both adapters share it. Include the new parity/contract test in verification_command.
C1-005.fix_risk: A defect in the shared helper could make both runtimes agree while simultaneously corrupting the mock oracle and contract-critical suite semantics.

C1-010.amendment: Split WO-009 into a lead-owned per-field semantics ruling followed by mechanical implementation. For each field, authority must specify enforced policy, descriptive provenance, reserved compatibility, or removal; absence of a runtime consumer is not enough to erase provenance. Preserve legacy manifests and referenced hashes through an explicit versioned reader/migration, with compatibility tests over the retained manifests and hash references.
C1-010.fix_risk: Deleting or reinterpreting fields could make historical hashed manifests unreadable, change referenced identities, or erase the recorded cache/cooldown conditions needed to interpret evidence.

C1-011.fix_risk: A poorly chosen extraction boundary could let a collection waiver clear claim-evidence failures or bypass the production shakedown/backup gate; the existing explicit PR59 regression tests and full 83-test portfolio must remain intact.

C1-012.amendment: Remove rider D3-005 from WO-034. Its three proposed deletions are outside bounded_scope and have not been shown to contain no unique unpromoted design content. Keep this work order limited to assigning owners/dependencies while preserving the packs' settled pre-registration requirements. Any later draft pruning needs a separate work order with exact paths and a content-migration/retention trace.
C1-012.fix_risk: Bundled pruning could destroy settled or not-yet-promoted design rationale, D-062 fixed-n rules, RIG-5 constraints, sentinel ordering, or other pre-registration content while ostensibly performing queue maintenance.

C1-013.fix_risk: The docs-only repair could accidentally rename the emitted fail-closed reason or conflate this local provenance vocabulary with D-057 reducer reason codes.

C1-014.fix_risk: Deleting checks assumed to be duplicate could remove claims-index-only key-order, linkage, absolute-path, editorial, or fixed_n admission safeguards and weaken the current unioned fail-closed gate.

C1-020.fix_risk: Public-path tests could mock away the very clock argument or HTML rendering seam they intend to observe, or become matplotlib-dependent and therefore skipped in bare CI.

C1-025.amendment: Narrow 'orphaned' to 'unreferenced in the tracked operating surface and dependent on private formats.' The charter excludes personal/untracked orchestration, and codex-watch provides live rollout rendering distinct from completion sentinels. Require Ed confirmation that no operator flow uses it and demonstrate a replacement for session discovery/live visibility before deletion. The grep acceptance must target operational paths and exclude immutable audit/history records, which will retain the name.
C1-025.fix_risk: Deletion could remove the only live visibility and recovery aid during launcher, status-file, or app-observability failures; a prose recipe may not reproduce that capability.

C2-001.amendment: Finding stands. WO-001 must define an explicit durable-custody acknowledgement, add vllm_runtime.py, nvidia_smi.py, interfaces.py and their tests to scope, and specify that KeyboardInterrupt/SystemExit cleanup does not swallow the original interrupt. NodeWorkerClient currently destroys local and remote custody before those adapters write into RunContext.
C2-001.fix_risk: Treating in-memory NodeTaskResult bytes as durable custody would preserve the same evidence-loss window while appearing fixed; deferred cleanup could also leak remote artifacts indefinitely.

C2-002.amendment: Finding stands. Replace WO-002's cross-product rejection-equivalence criterion with separate parity matrices: config validate versus exported config schema; SummaryMetrics writer validation versus summary schema and BundleReader; reducer output versus CLI admission. Add positive fixtures for valid succeeded, failed, unsupported, and additive-optional cases so parity does not mean indiscriminate strictness.
C2-002.fix_risk: An over-broad shared predicate could reject valid failure bundles or schema-compatible optional fields, breaking salvage and v0.1 compatibility while closing the null-summary case.

C2-003.amendment: Narrow the finding: realized fields already exist for single MLX runs, but are mislabelled or not enforced, while suite-level policy substitutes a synthetic aggregate stop. WO-003 must designate or replace the existing provenance fields rather than add a parallel record, preserve per-item suite outcomes instead of inventing one suite stop reason, cross-check counts against emitted token evidence, and include the new spike test in verification.
C2-003.fix_risk: Adding another outcome representation would deepen the validity fragmentation; collapsing heterogeneous suite outcomes into one realized stop could falsely restore ratio eligibility.

C2-005.amendment: Finding stands. WO-004 must add a positive production test where calibration bundles are distinct from consumer bundles, bind absolute observations, comparative ABBA members, and guard provenance to complete-bundle hashes and re-extracted strict summary metrics, and close the campaign-order binding required by the P2-039 specification. Add tests/test_cli.py to scope and verification.
C2-005.fix_risk: A fix that merely exposes FloorRequest while retaining consumer-pairs-subset matching would preserve circular calibration and still admit self-consistent fabricated floor values.

C2-006.fix_risk: A mutable repetition parameter not cryptographically bound at registry freeze could turn the repair into a sanctioned post-outcome sample-size switch or generate partial n=5/n=10 matrices with inconsistent block authority.

C2-007.amendment: WO-011 is under-scoped: an explicit exemption needs an authoritative validated policy field in the config or suite-manifest contract, with corresponding schema/config/contract scope. A neighboring non-prompt annotations sidecar must not itself count as exemption; tests must cover required text evidence, explicit affine-style exemption, unknown policy fail-closed, and unchanged ID-native behavior.
C2-007.fix_risk: Blanket rejection would break legitimate text suites without precomputed hashes, while filename or sidecar-schema heuristics would silently recreate the bypass.

C2-008.amendment: Choose the bounded diagnostic-browser disposition explicitly instead of leaving an implementation fork: display strict-validation state without hiding invalid/incomplete bundles, never imply claim readiness, and co-display request energy, boundary, tokenizer, and denominator provenance or explicit unknowns wherever token metrics appear.
C2-008.fix_risk: Turning the browser into an admission gate could hide the malformed runs it exists to diagnose; merely adding a diagnostic label could leave the token headline non-compliant.

C2-009.amendment: Keep rpt001-v1 immutable: its spec requires rpt001-v2 for material semantic changes and its claims row is hash-grandfathered. Expand scope to a complete v2 artifact and all report/default/test references; source runtime_output_tokens from token events/artifacts, never infer stop reason from count equaling the configured cap, and omit or downgrade the companion when stop/policy provenance remains unavailable.
C2-009.fix_risk: Rewriting v1 breaks reproducibility and its exact grandfather hash; inventing stop provenance would replace one false provenance claim with another.

C2-010.amendment: The finding stands, but WO-010(b) must require a unique per-dispatch correlation token echoed by the worker and validated with protocol_version, run_id, task_id, task_type, operation, and node_role before interpreting or deleting evidence. Existing task IDs are repeatable counters and status.json omits run_id, so checking existing fields cannot reject a matching stale response. Explicitly decide whether the added wire fields revise provisional v1 or bump its version, and test a stale response whose existing identity fields all match.
C2-010.fix_risk: Rejecting a mismatch only after remote cleanup could erase the evidence needed to diagnose it; persisting an unvalidated response version would also launder incompatible status data into bundle provenance.

C2-013.amendment: The governance-only gap is real, but WO-037 needs a non-self-asserted authority design. Separate an implementation-promotion receipt bound to the exact commit/protocol pins and lead-approved NV-GATE-2 evidence from per-bundle execution classification derived from the transport/adapter path; neither may be supplied by config or free-form metadata. Add the source-of-truth artifact, trust boundary, governed claim-exclusion reason, node-client/transport scope, and tests for fixture, unknown, unpromoted-live, and promoted-live cases. The current scope cannot reliably distinguish the patched StubNode fixture from real SSH execution.
C2-013.fix_risk: A freely writable promoted flag would make machine enforcement weaker than the current conspicuous governance gate by allowing fixture evidence to self-certify as live.

C2-014.fix_risk: Sanitizing instead of rejecting, using lexical prefix checks, or permitting dot components could alias distinct IDs or authorize the work root itself as an rm target, worsening the destructive-collision boundary.

C2-016.amendment: Finding stands, but WO-017 must distinguish clean-clone assembly/checking from full evidence re-derivation. A handoff contract alone is not evidence availability: acceptance must exercise source-only --check in a pristine clone and must not claim external full reproducibility unless an actually supplied, privacy-approved input pack completes the full command. Otherwise label full regeneration controlled/internal.
C2-016.fix_risk: The repair could either expose private raw evidence or replace an honest limitation with an unsupported external-reproducibility claim.

C2-017.amendment: Make WO-017 and WO-018 hard dependencies, not soft ones: the release check depends on their reproducible capstone handoff and repaired/pinned site toolchain. Define --dry-run as actual temporary-directory execution of every non-secret seam, not command printing or skip-to-success. Acceptance must distinguish a fixture/component smoke from full private-corpus regeneration and name corpus, network, Node/Lakebed, and credential boundaries explicitly.
C2-017.fix_risk: A release command that silently skips unavailable corpus or external tools could produce a green integrated gate while never exercising the publication boundary it claims to protect.

C2-018.amendment: Define the artifact-identity policy before claiming reproducible capsule bytes: pin exact Marked/Lakebed versions, record renderer mode and tool versions, and make builtAt/branch explicit reproducibility inputs or exclude them from byte-identity claims. Make the canonical size test use a controlled pinned/local builder or deterministic fixture; ambient npx-cache validation should be a separate optional integration gate. Preserve the tested offline renderer and hermetic --no-marked path.
C2-018.fix_risk: A network-dependent pin could destroy offline buildability, while leaving volatile build metadata or ambient-cache selection intact would falsely label non-reproducible artifacts deterministic.

C2-021.amendment: Finding stands, but WO-021 advertises complete-or-narrow while its acceptance permits only completion. Surface that choice to Ed. Because the audit gate will be historical during the fix wave, require either: (A) authoritative generic global-gate semantics, fidelity fixtures, the then-current live gate, and DOC-010's post-G6 dependency; or (B) explicit migration narrowing that removes generated source-of-truth/READY authority claims and retains manual authority. Retire prose only after parity, then run the focused and canonical suites.
C2-021.fix_risk: Encoding an already-cleared audit gate or deleting hand-authored prose before semantic parity could preserve—or worsen—the authority contradiction.

C2-022.amendment: Strengthen WO-013 acceptance around its keep-defender: default/--mode all must invoke the unified version-aware validator; exact legacy, current engine-linked, unknown, and hybrid rows need authority-case tests; ambiguous dialects must fail closed; and a differential mutation suite must preserve the old validators' union for supported dialects. Governed-surface tests must include report sources and exclude dated historical records while retaining D-059 warning-only prose exits.
C2-022.fix_risk: Field-presence dispatch could let hybrid rows bypass both schemas, or the refactor could remain absent from the default gate while appearing unified in explicit-mode tests.

C2-023.amendment: Finding stands, but WO-031 should refresh against the landing head, not merely install new pinned-head literals. Separate structural decision-index completeness from volatile status facts; generate those facts from an owner or prohibit fragile literals in designated current sections. Name the exact new test path and runnable command, scope checks away from dated history, and avoid hard-coding another model identifier that will drift.
C2-023.fix_risk: A literal-based freshness test can ossify today's suite count, PR state, and model name, turning every legitimate update into synchronized-doc churn or encouraging history rewrites.

C2-024.amendment: Finding stands. WO-005 cannot deliver its promised new reducer version with the current scope: add schemas.py and cli.py for the version constant and strict dispatch, plus bundle.py and bundle_read.py if interval support is serialized as first-class trace evidence. Freeze support-overlap and partial-edge semantics before implementation, and define duration-weighted idle variance/ESS and metadata cross-check behavior rather than changing only the mean.
C2-024.fix_risk: Applying whole-interval energy to partially overlapping windows, or pairing a weighted idle mean with the old unweighted HAC contract, would introduce a new systematic bias while silently invalidating historical strict re-reductions.

C2-025.amendment: Validate pairing within a phase-stream identity that includes node role/identity when present. Reject unmatched, reversed, and illegal same-stream overlaps, while allowing legitimate concurrent phases on distinct split nodes; require strict validation, phase attribution, and decode-token filtering to share this result.
C2-025.fix_risk: A global overlap prohibition would reject valid parallel-node evidence, while separate validator and reducer implementations could preserve the current fail-open divergence.

C2-026.amendment: Forbid an in-place semantic conversion of gpu_freq_hz_mean because legacy and current values would become indistinguishable. Pin an additive gpu_freq_mhz_mean field, retain and document the old field as a deprecated legacy-MHz alias, preserve rich telemetry verbatim, and remove the active-claim-affecting characterization.
C2-026.fix_risk: Reinterpreting the existing field as Hz silently mixes eras by 1e6; converting rich records would also violate byte-regenerability.

C2-027.amendment: Replace the claim that no sensitivity analysis exists: suite_implementation_research.md already contains one, but D-047 invalidates its 40–80-item pseudo-replication premise. Correct that paragraph, add the AP-5 pointer, document D-047-consistent n=8 discrete behavior and attainable decision boundaries, and defer empirical robustness to the first smoke/P2-015 evidence rather than fabricating it pre-data.
C2-027.fix_risk: Outcome-dependent threshold retuning after the smoke, or treating repeated bundles as independent token observations, could launder a failed envelope into a pass.

C2-028.amendment: Pin one deterministic recursive quarantine contract rather than leaving diagnostics versus quarantine to the implementer: no str/repr payloads, path-addressed diagnostics, cycle handling, non-string-key handling, and non-finite-number handling, while valid metadata remains unchanged and D-011 finalization survives. Specify where diagnostics live; if a new top-level metadata field is used, add publication-privacy policy and tests to scope.
C2-028.fix_risk: A broad catch-and-replace implementation could discard an entire valid metadata subtree or mask writer defects; an unbounded recursive sanitizer could still crash on cycles and defeat D-011.

C2-029.amendment: Capture source state at RunBundleWriter creation before adapters execute, and record an end-state comparison so mid-run source changes become claim-ineligible; the current git lookup occurs only when metadata is written after measurement. Define tracked, staged, untracked, unknown, and changed-during-run semantics plus the diff-identity algorithm. Add validation and analysis claim-admission modules/tests to bounded_scope: the present scope cannot implement its own action. Dirty, unknown, or changed provenance must hard-exclude claim-bearing evidence rather than merely be flagged, while bundle completion remains allowed.
C2-029.fix_risk: An end-only check can label a run with source state that did not produce its measurements, while treating git-probe failure as clean or allowing a warning-only claim path would preserve the original reproducibility defect under new fields.

C2-030.amendment: Constrain consolidation so node_worker remains a self-contained deployed artifact: deduplicate its termination paths only through within-file parameterization, with no controller-side imports, while retaining distinct process maps, per-backend timeouts, PID-identity checks, log salvage, clock alignment, and cleanup outcomes. Repository-only absence is insufficient to delete public TransportAdapter methods; formally establish internal-only status or provide deprecation compatibility. Expand verification to node-worker, subprocess, SSH, interface/controller, and failure-path tests.
C2-030.fix_risk: An over-shared lifecycle abstraction could strand remote processes, apply the wrong timeout or PID map, lose worker logs/clock evidence, or break external transport consumers.

C2-032.amendment: WO-015 must forbid rewriting the sealed rpt001-v1 digest values in place. Name the tab-delimited identity as the legacy v1 algorithm, retain validation for it, and emit the canonical NUL-delimited identity only in a new explicitly versioned artifact path after WO-014 chooses the dataset version. Add an algorithm/version field and cross-pipeline equality fixture; expand scope to the new analysis/figure version instead of only analysis/rpt001-v1.
C2-032.fix_risk: Rehashing rpt001-v1 in place would silently change bundle identities and cascade through its input manifest, dataset, artifact manifest, figures, and publication IDs, destroying the sealed artifact’s audit trail.

C2-033.fix_risk: An imprecise deletion could remove _file_entries or a privacy-audit pass instead of only the dead private files key, weakening symlink/non-file rejection, source-immutability detection, or public-manifest verification.

C2-034.amendment: Narrow 'no active consumer' to the live payload fields proven unused by the browser; long-form pages have human advisor consumers. Before deleting pages, record an explicit retained route/page inventory based on value-versus-bytes review and preserve navigation rails, the source library, deep links, long-form evidence access, and provenance stamps. Acceptance must include route/link checks and per-page retention decisions, not only 'consumed views unchanged.'
C2-034.fix_risk: Byte trimming could remove advisor-visible evidence and stable deep links that have no machine consumer, hollowing out the site's auditability for modest size savings.

C2-035.amendment: Correct the finding: CLAUDE.md has one detailed effort pointer plus a second bare pointer, not two multi-clause trigger lists; the agent/command effort pointers comply with D-065. Keep the supported wire-restatement concern, but require a clause-by-clause canonical/pointer/enforcement-boundary inventory. WO-020 must either name the intended claude-consult change or remove that skill from scope, define canonical snippets before demanding byte identity, and directly run the new drift checker plus unittest verification.
C2-035.fix_risk: Deduplication can remove prompt-only enforcement where no adapter validates it, while an overbroad byte-identity rule can couple context-specific surfaces and create false assurance.

C2-036.amendment: The cost evidence and missing numeric bands are supported, but WO-022 must remain an Ed-ratification proposal rather than presupposing caps. Specify accounting source, denominator, arc/window boundaries, cached-token treatment, deliverable-progress measure, exceptions, owner, and trigger consequence. If the tripwire is called mechanical, add an executable checker with exact scope and tests; gen_state --check cannot verify this policy. Correct stale R-018 independently.
C2-036.fix_risk: Crude ceilings can suppress uniquely valuable claim/evidence safeguards or incentivize gaming through split arcs and distorted accounting.
